name: Coffee Cosmos
source:
It's hard to start your life over – especially when you're doing it in a new place with nothing to your name. 

But by a stroke of luck, you landed a position at a prestigious coffee shop downtown. The pay is great, the hours are consistent, and if you can keep up with the workload, you should be able to rent a place nearby in no time at all. Things are looking up.

[From [url=https://heecawroo.itch.io/cosmos]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
重新开始你的生活是很困难的——尤其是当你在一个一无所有的新地方生活时。

但幸运的是，你在市中心一家著名的咖啡馆找到了一份工作。工资很高，工作时间稳定，如果你能跟上工作量，你应该很快就能在附近租到地方。事情正在好转。

[来自[url=https://heecawroo.itch.io/cosmos]Itch.io[/url]]
